items.name: Direct fuel combustion: Gaseous fuels / Butane (t, UK dataset 2026)
items.activity: Fuels / Gaseous fuels / Butane
items.gas_coverage: CO2, CH4 and N2O aggregated as CO2e; source separately excludes reportable biogenic CO2 where applicable.
items.accounting_boundary: Scope 1 direct combustion in an owned or controlled site/asset; excludes well-to-tank upstream emissions. Biogenic CO2, where relevant, is reported separately outside scopes.
items.methodology: UK DESNZ 2026 methodology; CO2e uses IPCC AR5 100-year global warming potentials per full-set Introduction!A35, subject to worksheet-specific methods.
items.notes: Full-set 'Fuels'!A8,A11:A13,A19. Net/gross calorific value and fuel blend must match the activity data; UK natural-gas and average-biofuel blend assumptions are source-specific. Reference factor for the source geography and reporting year; not an India default. Company applicability requires a matching activity, geography, period, unit and accounting boundary.

Reference factor for the source geography and reporting year; not an India default. Company applicability requires a matching activity, geography, period, unit and accounting boundary.

Company applicability requires a matching activity, geography, period, unit and accounting boundary.

items.name: India weighted-average grid electricity, FY2023-24 (CO2 only, historical)
items.activity: Weighted Average Emissions Factor of Grid Electricity (Including RE)
items.gas_coverage: CO2 only; does not include CH4 or N2O and must not be relabelled CO2e.
items.accounting_boundary: Historical weighted-average grid electricity generation including renewable energy; source table adjusts 2022-23 onward for cross-border electricity transfers and includes injections from grid-connected captive plants. Generation basis, not lifecycle or a separately calculated T&D-loss factor.
items.methodology: CEA weighted-average grid CO2 factor reproduced by NITI Aayog, Annexure E. Numerically equivalent units: 1 t CO2/MWh = 1 kg CO2/kWh. This is a historical annual average, not a market-based or marginal factor.
items.notes: Historical fiscal-year reference; no claim of current-year applicability. Do not treat CO2-only results as complete BRSR Scope 2 CO2e. The source is a government analytical report reproducing CEA baseline v21.0, not a verification that this is the latest CEA release.
